name: Baiin Reijou ~Suouin Sakurako no Zaiwai~
original_name: 売淫令嬢 ～周防院櫻子の罪穢～
source:
The story follows Suouin Sakurako, born into a prestigious family that faces financial ruin. To save her father, she agrees to auction herself at an exclusive club, leading to her sacrificing her purity and facing exploitation. An unexpected pregnancy leads to further degradation, triggering a transformation in her nature. As she navigates torment and pleasure, Sakurako confronts a crucial choice that will determine her future path.

translation:
故事讲述了出生于面临经济破产的名门世家的周防院樱子。为了拯救父亲，她同意在一家高级俱乐部拍卖自己，牺牲了自己的纯洁并遭受了剥削。意外的怀孕导致了更深的堕落，引发了她本性的转变。在痛苦与欢愉之间挣扎时，樱子面临着一个将决定她未来道路的关键抉择。
